data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The simulation program should be a single def simulate(inputs, rng) returning a tuple of the first ten (X_n, die_n) pairs plus the six final counts (count_1..count_6) and total, ignoring the rng argument since the recurrence is fully deterministic.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the program is not a single def simulate(inputs, rng) with nothing else, reject.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the program does not return (calibration, count_1..count_6, total) as flat observables, reject.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the recurrence uses X_(n+1) for die_n instead of X_n, reject.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the implementation modifies X_0 from 42 or alters constants, reject.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The function computes X_(n+1) = (1103515245 * X_n + 12345) mod 2^31 starting from X_0=42, maps each X_n to 1 + (X_n mod 6), and iterates exactly 10000 times while collecting calibration and tallying face counts.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
